role: Frozen candidate transfer across four previously inspected low/high single/S routes; bank2 is shared, not randomized. Nominal and +/-36N are paired. Original goal arrival and full H10 survival are separate; all failures retained.
window_semantics: Pulse: actual nonzero applied impulse transfers; pre-goal occupancy: integer control transitions through first arrival, excluding subsequent actions.
cost_scope: Per-source user alpha, actual observed window; no terminal replacement included. Do not compare different-alpha weighted costs.
